P.name: Loaded Dice
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Twisted Fate''' kills an enemy, he generates {{g|icononly=true}}{{pp|type=chance|1 to 6 for 6|key1=%|100*2/3/5 to 100*2/3/5;100/3|color=gold}}. He also has a chance equal to his {{as|critical strike chance}} to generate an additional {{g|{{pp|type=chance|1 to 6 for 6|key1=%|100/3;100*2/3/5 to 100*2/3/5|color=gold}}}}.

Q.name: Wild Cards
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twisted Fate''' throws a fan of three cards in a cone in the target direction that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.description2: ''Enemies can be damaged only once per pass.''

W.name: Pick a Card
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twisted Fate''' cycles through three cards for 6 seconds, hovering each for {{fd|0.5}} seconds at a time. ''Pick a Card'' can be recast within the duration, which selects the current card hovered.
W.description2: {{Anchor|Blue Card}}{{sbc|Recast:}} '''Twisted Fate''' empowers his next  {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time, deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}, and apply an additional effect based on the card selected. This attack cannot {{tip|critically strike}} but its damage is increased based on {{as|critical strike chance}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Blue Card Bonus:}} Deals {{as|magic damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 57.5 for 11|0 to 100|formula=57.5% x critical strike chance, capped at 57.5% increase}}|critical chance}}, and restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{st|Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|70 to 150}}|mana}}}}
W.description4: {{Anchor|Red Card}}{{sbc|Red Card Bonus:}} Deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 35 for 11|0 to 100|formula=35% x critical strike chance, capped at 35% increase}}|critical chance}}. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
W.description5: {{Anchor|Gold Card}}{{sbc|Gold Card Bonus:}} Deals {{as|magic damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 25 for 11|0 to 100|formula=25% x critical strike chance, capped at 25% increase}}|critical chance}}, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for a duration.
W.leveling5:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|15 to 45}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
W.description6: ''Pick a Card's recast {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Twisted Fate's''' basic attack timer. The recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

E.name: Stacked Deck
E.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Twisted Fate''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Stacked Deck'', stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack is empowered to consume them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, reduced to 50% against structures.

'''Twisted Fate''' gains maximum stacks of ''Stacked Deck'' upon [[death|respawning]].
E.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|15 to 55}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 165}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}

R.name: Destiny
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twisted Fate''' marks all targetable enemy champions, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for a duration. ''Destiny'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast - Gate:}} '''Twisted Fate''' {{tip|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds before {{tip|blink|blinking}} to the target location, {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroying}} enemy {{tip|projectiles}} targeting him in the process.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|170 to 110}}|Starts after recast times out or is used}}
